title: Developer Quickstart & Cost Framing — Hosted API
summary: A short playbook for messaging the Hosted API to developers: emphasize immediate time-to-first-response, predictable millisecond-level latency, transparent unit economics, and low friction SDK/cURL experience. Includes three quickstart angles and three pricing language options for experiments.
problem_statement: Developers perceive LLM APIs as 'fast but expensive and unpredictable.' We need a developer-first narrative that reduces fear of cost, highlights performance predictability, and gets teams to a meaningful first metric within 30 minutes.
target_audience: Early-stage startups building product features (seed to Series B)
Platform/infra engineers prototyping ML features for SaaS products
Developer advocates and technical PMs evaluating LLM vendors
core_messages: Zero-friction first response: 5-minute cURL + SDK examples that return streaming text or embeddings with sample data
Predictable performance: model profiles with p50/p95 latency and per-model token-cost estimates
Cost controls for dev workflows: sandbox credits, dev quotas, and commit+burst options to avoid surprise bills
Switch-friendly: same API surface across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments to reduce lock-in risk
Measureable impact fast: templates that show 'first meaningful metric' (e.g., conversion lift, search NDCG) in 30–90 minutes
quickstart_angles: 1) Minimal friction: '5-minute bot' — cURL + node/python SDK with a single request that streams a chat response; ends with a one-line curl + copyable env var for API_KEY
2) Product-first sample: 'Search booster in 30' — plug your small dataset (CSV or docs) and run embeddings + nearest-neighbor demo; shows quality improvement metric vs baseline
3) Cost-sim demo: 'Estimate before you run' — interactive demo that shows token usage and projected cost for a realistic workload, paired with suggested batching/quantization settings
quickstart_steps: Install SDK or use cURL (1 cmd)
Set API key (one-liner using env var)
Run sample request (chat/generate or embed) that returns streaming output
Paste output into provided validator (quality checklist) or run the small benchmark script
See an estimated cost card and suggested next steps (scale, commit, private deploy)
pricing_language_options: A) Dev-first PAYG: 'Free sandbox credits, then pay-as-you-go with clear per-1k-token rates and daily quota controls. Ideal for experimentation.'
B) Commit+Burst for teams: 'Monthly committed throughput at discounted unit rates with burst capacity and predictable billing — recommended once you cross 3M tokens/month.'
C) Hybrid entry: 'Sandbox + dev credits, auto-suggested micro-commit that reduces unit price after 30 days if usage is sustained. Eases transition from experiment to predictable spend.'
competitive_differentiators: Operational transparency: published p50/p95 latency and token-cost per model, not just price lists
Unified API surface across hosted/dedicated/private reduces rework when customers scale
Built-in cost controls and sandboxed dev quotas specifically designed for developer experimentation
Out-of-the-box quickstart templates tied to measurable metrics (conversion, NDCG, time-savings) rather than generic demos
objections_and_rebuttals: Objection: 'Too expensive — we can't predict cost.'
Rebuttal: show live cost estimator during quickstart, suggest batching/quantization profiles, offer dev quotas and commit+burst options to cap spend.
Rebuttal: emphasize identical API and SDK behavior across hosting modes and migration paths plus model aliasing and exportable prompt sets.
Objection: 'Latency is variable on cloud endpoints.'
Rebuttal: publish model latency profiles, use smart routing and fallback tiers, and offer dedicated pools for predictable SLOs.
experiments_and_metrics: A/B copy tests on landing page: '5-minute integration' vs 'Accuracy-first' messaging — measure signups and time-to-first-call metrics
Track: percentage of new signups that hit 'first API call' within 24h; target >= 40%
Measure: reduction in average cost-per-query after showing cost-sim demo and suggested optimizer settings; target 15% reduction
Qual: developer NPS on quickstart flow; target >= 8/10 for devs who complete the tutorial
next_steps: 1) Build 3 quickstart pages (bot, search, cost-sim) with one-click SDK snippets (web + GitHub repo)
2) Wire cost-estimator UI into quickstart and surface suggested optimizations (batching, model choice)
3) Run 2 landing-page copy experiments for 4 weeks and measure funnel metrics
4) Share draft messaging with sales & solutions engineering for feedback and carve out enterprise disclaimers
informal_notes: Notes to self: keep examples tiny but realistic. Use a small public dataset for search demo (e.g., tiny-corpora) so devs can try without uploading PII.
